title: The number was gasoline
dek: September CPI hit 3.7 percent and the Fed hike odds jumped. Core was 2.6. They were never the same argument.
quote: "Three point seven was gasoline, and gasoline was a war. A central bank cannot drill for oil. Watch which number Warsh says out loud on October 28."
cta: ▸ Read the full recollection of the events that follow.
disclaimer: Constructed content. Not a forecast, not advice.
